items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: I've had quite a few to tell me that, such as Nick LaRocka, Larry.

ctx.x: He always had a bunch of young kids. He said some of them stayed at his house even.

Well, I imagine Jack just about gave all these guys their first start in the music business. And of course I've had quite a few to tell me that, such as Nick LaRocka, Larry. But Larry played with quite a few bands around here before he left, he played with the marching bands, you know, and played with Joe Ella Bush. I remember he had his conductor's cap and he just changed the name of the band, you know, and just put it over the cap and drive it.
